'''Davon Kull''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]]. Imprisoned in [[Belsavis prison]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was among those prisoners who broke free during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]]. While threatening a Republic guard, he was approached by Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who asked him about the whereabout of [[the Circle]] gang.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Davon Kull appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Belsavis.
